scope.en: Curated terms used by Chapters 00–34. firstDefinitionChapter is an editorial pointer, not an automatically inferred first word occurrence.
scope.zh: 第 00–34 章使用的策展术语。firstDefinitionChapter 是编辑性入口，不是按词面自动推断的首次出现位置。

definition.en: A composable runtime contribution mounted into a context and owned by a lifecycle scope; it may publish services, listeners, and reversible effects.
definition.zh: 挂载到 Context、由生命周期 Scope 持有的可组合运行时贡献；它可以发布 Service、监听器和可逆 Effect。

definition.en: A typed capability published under a context key and consumed through scope-aware lookup rather than direct global ownership.
definition.zh: 发布在 Context 键下、通过 Scope 感知查找使用的类型化能力，而不是由全局对象直接持有。

definition.en: A named live-bus contract whose TypeScript signature and dispatch mode constrain producers and listeners; it is distinct from a durable Session log record.
definition.zh: 由 TypeScript 签名和派发模式约束生产者与监听器的命名实时总线契约；它不同于持久化 Session 日志记录。

definition.en: A side-effect registration paired with a disposer and owned by the current lifecycle fiber, so replacement can retract what it published.
definition.zh: 与 Disposer 配对并由当前生命周期 Fiber 持有的副作用注册，使替换过程能够撤回自身发布的内容。

definition.en: The callable cleanup handle returned by a registration; ownership and reverse teardown make it part of the runtime contract, not optional housekeeping.
definition.zh: 注册操作返回的可调用清理句柄；所有权和逆序拆卸使它成为运行时契约的一部分，而非可选的收尾工作。

definition.en: An ordered live-event mode in which a listener can transform a value and delegate to the next listener; before/after-next placement is semantic.
definition.zh: 监听器可变换值并委托给下一个监听器的有序实时事件模式；逻辑位于 next 前后具有语义差异。

definition.en: A visibility and ownership boundary that determines which contributions are observable and which lifecycle must retract them.
definition.zh: 同时界定可见性和所有权的边界，决定哪些贡献可被观察，以及由哪个生命周期撤回。

definition.en: The runtime lifecycle node that owns a plugin activation and its effects; disposing it retracts its owned contribution graph.
definition.zh: 持有插件激活及其 Effect 的运行时生命周期节点；释放它会撤回其拥有的贡献图。

definition.en: A named launch composition that selects and layers bundles and patches into an effective plugin tree.
definition.zh: 选择并叠加 Bundle 与 Patch、形成有效插件树的命名启动组合。

definition.en: A reusable product-level configuration layer that assembles a coherent set of plugins and defaults.
definition.zh: 组装一组相互协调的插件与默认值、可复用的产品级配置层。

definition.en: A configuration-tree operation that adds, replaces, or removes a row by stable identity as composition layers are applied.
definition.zh: 组合层叠加时按稳定身份添加、替换或删除配置行的配置树操作。

definition.en: The stable key used to decide which configuration row a later layer replaces; textual position alone is not identity.
definition.zh: 用于判断后续配置层替换哪一行的稳定键；文本位置本身不是身份。

definition.en: A runtime object with identity, scope, inbox, status, and a Session-backed execution lifecycle; it is published only after setup succeeds.
definition.zh: 具备身份、Scope、Inbox、状态和 Session 支撑的执行生命周期的运行时对象；只有准备成功后才会发布。

definition.en: A user- or system-triggered execution interval that may contain several Steps and ends with an explicit reason.
definition.zh: 由用户或系统触发、可包含多个 Step，并以明确原因结束的执行区间。

definition.en: One prompt assembly and model-request attempt inside a Turn, followed by either completion or a tool-continuation boundary.
definition.zh: Turn 内的一次提示词组装与模型请求尝试，随后进入完成或工具续跑边界。

definition.en: The canonical logged snapshot of request-shaping context used to reconstruct and compare model requests.
definition.zh: 用于重建并比较模型请求的、规范化记录下来的请求塑形上下文快照。

definition.en: An append-only typed record in a Session log with sequence, time, payload, and optional Surface metadata; it is not a live Cordis event.
definition.zh: Session 日志中带序号、时间、负载及可选 Surface 元数据的追加式类型记录；它不是实时 Cordis 事件。

definition.en: The exact transition after which a candidate is authoritative; failures before it veto publication, while later observer failures cannot undo the fact.
definition.zh: 候选值转为权威事实的精确转折点；此前失败可否决发布，此后观察者失败不能撤销该事实。

definition.en: The ordered model-visible message projection derived from eligible Session events; it is a view over the log rather than the canonical log itself.
definition.zh: 从合格 Session 事件派生的有序模型可见消息投影；它是日志之上的视图，而不是规范日志本身。

definition.en: The append, replace, or delete operation carried by a Surface-eligible event to fold model-visible history deterministically.
definition.zh: 由 Surface 合格事件携带的追加、替换或删除操作，用于确定性折叠模型可见历史。

definition.en: Reconstructing derived runtime or model-visible state by folding durable facts in sequence order rather than trusting a resident cache.
definition.zh: 按序折叠持久化事实来重建派生运行时状态或模型可见状态，而不是信任驻留缓存。

definition.en: Per-Session asynchronous persistence that preserves append order but needs an explicit flush barrier before selected external effects.
definition.zh: 按 Session 维持追加顺序的异步持久化；在特定外部副作用前需要显式 Flush Barrier。

definition.en: An awaited boundary that makes the required log prefix durable before a model request, top-level tool body, or another selected side effect proceeds.
definition.zh: 在模型请求、顶层工具主体或其他指定副作用继续前，等待所需日志前缀完成持久化的边界。

definition.en: A fold or query-derived view over authoritative records; a projection can accelerate reads without becoming the source of truth.
definition.zh: 基于权威记录折叠或查询得到的视图；Projection 可以加速读取，但不会因此成为事实来源。

definition.en: The log position and identity metadata that bound what a cached projection has folded and whether tail replay is safe.
definition.zh: 界定缓存 Projection 已折叠到何处、以及尾部重放是否安全的日志位置与身份元数据。

definition.en: A logged Surface replacement that summarizes an eligible prefix to reduce future model context without deleting canonical history.
definition.zh: 把合格前缀总结为一条已记录的 Surface 替换，以降低后续模型上下文成本，但不删除规范历史。

definition.en: A selected interaction mode whose transition commits immediately when idle or at the next accepted in-Turn pre-Step boundary.
definition.zh: 一种交互模式选择；空闲时立即提交，Turn 进行中则在下一个被接受的 pre-Step 边界提交。

definition.en: A revisioned, phase-bearing objective updated through exact-reference checks and a durable Session commit before live publication.
definition.zh: 带修订号和阶段的目标；更新时先校验精确引用并完成持久化 Session 提交，再实时发布。

definition.en: A whole-value list state with its own validation and projection contract; it does not inherit Goal or Plan authority semantics.
definition.zh: 具有独立校验和 Projection 契约的整值列表状态；它不继承 Goal 或 Plan 的权威语义。

definition.en: The ordered execution transaction spanning input materialization, policy, guards, around-dispatch, body execution, post-policy, finalization, and immutable result.
definition.zh: 覆盖输入物化、策略、Guard、Around 派发、主体执行、后置策略、最终化和不可变结果的有序执行事务。

definition.en: A policy hook that may deny or abstain but cannot grant authority, so a later guard cannot reverse an earlier veto.
definition.zh: 只能拒绝或弃权、不能授予权限的策略 Hook，因此后续 Guard 无法推翻先前否决。

definition.en: A request-scoped human decision with a closed outcome vocabulary; approval is not a reusable ambient permission.
definition.zh: 请求作用域内、具有封闭结果词汇的人类决定；一次审批不是可复用的环境权限。

definition.en: Per-call policy for declared process file effects and writable roots; its documented boundary is not general network, syscall, device, or credential isolation.
definition.zh: 针对声明的进程文件副作用与可写根目录逐调用解析的策略；其文档边界不是通用网络、系统调用、设备或凭据隔离。

definition.en: Session-owned freshness metadata recorded by selected filesystem tools; it is narrower than proof that every byte was read or every filesystem access was observed.
definition.zh: 由特定文件系统工具记录、归 Session 所有的新鲜度元数据；它不等同于证明每个字节均被读取或所有文件访问均被观察。

definition.en: A model-facing presentation and dispatch mode that exposes generated SDK bindings; it does not create a second, authority-free tool engine.
definition.zh: 向模型暴露生成式 SDK Binding 的呈现与派发模式；它不会创建第二套不受权限约束的工具引擎。

definition.en: The transition in which a validated contribution becomes visible in a scope; activation must have explicit ownership and disposal.
definition.zh: 已校验贡献在某个 Scope 中变为可见的转折；激活必须具有明确所有权和释放路径。

definition.en: A child execution created through a provider seam with explicit parent ownership, run identity, settlement, budgets, and optional continuation.
definition.zh: 通过 Provider Seam 创建、具有明确父级所有权、运行身份、结算、预算和可选续跑能力的子执行。

definition.en: A child whose stable descriptor and Session permit later follow-up epochs; publication occurs only after setup and inbox acceptance succeed.
definition.zh: 依靠稳定 Descriptor 与 Session 支持后续 Follow-up Epoch 的子 Agent；仅在准备和 Inbox 接受成功后发布。

definition.en: A validated orchestration program that composes child runs and combinators under explicit concurrency, total-child, slice, and disposal ceilings.
definition.zh: 在明确的并发、子任务总量、同步 Slice 与释放时限下组合子运行和 Combinator 的已校验编排程序。

definition.en: The durable transition that assigns queued input to an execution boundary, preserving ordering and recovery semantics across cancellation or restart.
definition.zh: 把排队输入分配给执行边界的持久化转折，跨取消或重启保留顺序与恢复语义。

definition.en: The typed request, response, and notification carrier used by API and ACP surfaces; envelope validation does not by itself establish user identity.
definition.zh: API 与 ACP 表面使用的类型化请求、响应和通知载体；信封校验本身不建立用户身份。

definition.en: A monotonic client-side epoch that prevents stale work from an earlier transport from mutating the current connected state.
definition.zh: 客户端单调递增的 Epoch，用于防止旧传输上的过期工作修改当前连接状态。

definition.en: A scope-owned browser contribution point whose recursive disposal removes the subtree declared by an entry.
definition.zh: 由 Scope 持有的浏览器贡献点；其递归释放会移除某个 Entry 声明的整个子树。

definition.en: A named transition where identity, authority, data origin, or side-effect capability changes and therefore requires explicit validation or policy.
definition.zh: 身份、权限、数据来源或副作用能力发生变化、因而需要显式校验或策略的命名转折。

definition.en: A package-owned executable check of a semantic property at runtime; it complements static types and tests rather than replacing either.
definition.zh: 由 Package 持有、在运行时检查语义性质的可执行规则；它补充静态类型和测试，而不是替代它们。

definition.en: A stable catalog ID tied to one pinned repository path and line range, with bilingual statements of what that excerpt supports.
definition.zh: 绑定到固定仓库路径与行号范围的稳定目录 ID，并以双语说明该摘录支持什么。

definition.en: The exact upstream commit against which every path, line range, generated index, and architectural statement in this study is evaluated.
definition.zh: 本研究中每个路径、行号范围、生成索引和架构陈述共同依赖的精确上游提交。

definition.en: The share of catalog IDs cited by an eligible chapter corpus, counting one bilingual chapter once; it is not claim coverage, source-file coverage, or proof quality.
definition.zh: 合格章节语料引用过的目录 ID 占比；双语章节只计一次。它不是 Claim 覆盖、源码文件覆盖或证明质量。
